main_measure.name: mean next-bar excess return (vs coin's all-window mean daily return) on bars with forecast >= 5
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with ordinary t >= 2 and high-vol minus low-vol > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean excess high-vol half minus low-vol half (split at pooled median 60-day std)

decided_by: Mean excess > 0 with t >= 2 and high-vol minus low-vol difference > 0 (confirm rule).
reading: Situation bars are those where the recorded vol-scaled 1-day return (price return where unrecorded) is below 0, long side; the 60-day std is recomputed within each window (60 returns, min 60, missing earlier), the high-volatility half is std > pooled median of cases with a std and the low half is std <= median, and the plan's minimum counts not reached give 'not observable'.
